answer: Locks are recorded in yarrow, expire in pearl, and crystal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 63 aliases therefore needs 18 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4431 identities would post 4179 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
